stem.archstudio.toolbox_intro: Explore, inspect, and share your build.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_empty_help: Try another word or reset the filters.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_needs_blocks: Add blocks to use this tool.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_needs_replay: Exit replay to use this tool.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_style_help: Choose the architect or brick-building appearance.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_blueprint_help: Switch the model between blueprint and 3D appearance.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_challenges_help: Choose a building challenge and track completed goals.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_analysis_help: Inspect stability, support, and structural tips.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_inquiry_help: Test ideas and compare what happens to your structure.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_templates_help: Preview a starting structure and place it beside your build.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_ai_help: Request design advice for your current building.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_budget_help: Turn the material budget on or off and track spending.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_schedule_help: Count materials or shapes for the whole build or one floor.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_stats_help: Review the dimensions and quantities in your structure.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_styles_help: Explore architectural styles and their defining features.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_phases_help: Review the building stages in your design.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_share_help: Create or open a code for exchanging builds.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_generate_help: Explore a randomly generated building as a starting point.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_colors_help: Choose custom colors for building and painting.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_slice_help: Look through a cross-section of the building.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_heatmap_help: Highlight structural stress in the model.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_replay_help: Enter or exit a step-by-step replay of the build.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_filter_help: Show selected materials to inspect parts of your build.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_badges_help: See the achievements earned while building.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_floorplans_help: Show plans for the floors of your building.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_gravity_help: Drop floating blocks onto the structure below.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_screenshot_help: Capture an image of the current view.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_sound_help: Turn building sounds on or off.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_topsvg_help: Download a vector drawing of the build from above.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_sidesvg_help: Download a vector elevation of the build.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_printlab_help: Continue this building in Print Lab to prepare a print.
stem.archstudio.toolbox_stl_help: Download the building as a 3D model for printing.
